exposure: Prostaglandin (PG) E(2) for preterm labor induction
Bishop score change after removal of PGE(2)
Gestational age at induction (24-31, 32-33, and 34-36 weeks)
outcome: Intrapartum complications (tachysystole, nonreassuring fetal heart rate, postpartum bleeding)
cohort: 155 women at 24+0 to 36+6 weeks of gestation who underwent induction of labor using a PGE(2) vaginal pessary
finding: Multiparity, younger maternal age, advanced gestational age at induction, rupture of membranes, and Bishop score change after PGE(2) removal were significant predictors of successful preterm vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Multiparity, younger maternal age, advanced gestational age at induction, rupture of membranes, and Bishop score change after PGE(2) removal were significant predictors of successful preterm vaginal delivery.
